meta.note: Default weights mirrored from X's feature-switch defaults (synced 2026-08-12). Values are live-tunable server-side and can be overridden per-user by experiments.

engagement_weights.name: Copy-link share
engagement_weights.explanation: The single most valuable positive action — 40x a like. Content people copy the link to send elsewhere wins.

engagement_weights.name: Reply
engagement_weights.explanation: A reply is worth 10x a like — conversation is king.

engagement_weights.name: Share via DM
engagement_weights.explanation: Posts people DM to friends are rewarded like replies.

engagement_weights.name: Follow from post
engagement_weights.explanation: A post that makes someone follow you is worth 8x a like.

engagement_weights.name: Retweet
engagement_weights.explanation: A retweet is worth 2x a like.

engagement_weights.name: Like
engagement_weights.explanation: Likes barely move the needle relative to everything else.

engagement_weights.name: Click into post
engagement_weights.explanation: Detail clicks are worth slightly less than a like.

engagement_weights.name: Open external link
engagement_weights.explanation: External link clicks are one of the weakest positive signals.

engagement_weights.name: Photo expand
engagement_weights.explanation: Expanding a photo gives a tiny boost.

engagement_weights.name: Video open
engagement_weights.explanation: Opening a video gives a tiny boost.

engagement_weights.name: Quality video view
engagement_weights.explanation: Quality video views count a little, and only on videos longer than 10 seconds.

engagement_weights.name: Dwell time (per second)
engagement_weights.explanation: Each predicted second spent on your post adds value — held attention accumulates.

penalties.name: Report
penalties.explanation: Catastrophic — a predicted report outweighs ~468 likes. Rage-bait that gets reported dies.

penalties.name: Mute author
penalties.explanation: Being mute-worthy is punished almost 2x harder than being block-worthy.

penalties.name: Not interested
penalties.explanation: A 'Not interested' click costs the equivalent of ~86 likes.

penalties.name: Block author
penalties.explanation: A predicted block wipes out ~62 likes of value.

penalties.name: Scrolled past
penalties.explanation: Posts people scroll straight past take a small deduction.

boosts_and_rescoring.name: Mutual-follow reply boost
boosts_and_rescoring.explanation: Original posts from authors who mutually follow the viewer get 4x the conversation reward — build real mutuals.

boosts_and_rescoring.name: Out-of-network discount
boosts_and_rescoring.explanation: Posts shown to non-followers are scored at 75% — going viral outside your audience is an uphill battle by design.

boosts_and_rescoring.name: Reply/retweet discount
boosts_and_rescoring.explanation: Your replies and retweets are scored at 75% even for your own followers — original posts are structurally favored.

boosts_and_rescoring.name: Author diversity decay
boosts_and_rescoring.explanation: Your 2nd post in one feed load is worth ~62%, 3rd ~44%, floored at 25% — flooding the timeline doesn't stack.

boosts_and_rescoring.name: Small-account discovery boost
boosts_and_rescoring.explanation: One post per feed load from an author with ≤1,000 followers and <1,000 views (<24h old) gets guaranteed mid-feed placement.

boosts_and_rescoring.name: Net-negative squash
boosts_and_rescoring.explanation: If penalties outweigh positives, the post ranks below every net-positive post, period.

boosts_and_rescoring.name: Feed diversity rerank
boosts_and_rescoring.explanation: Posts too similar to others already picked for the feed get demoted — near-duplicate takes lose.

account_signals.name: Credibility = PageRank over follows
account_signals.explanation: Your account credibility comes from who follows you — follows and likes from credible accounts pass credibility to you.

account_signals.name: Verified accounts get a credibility floor
account_signals.explanation: Premium/verified accounts get built-in baseline credibility that unverified accounts must earn through the graph.

account_signals.name: Selective likes count more
account_signals.explanation: A like from a selective account is worth more to your credibility than a like from someone who likes everything.

account_signals.name: Engagement-baiting is a policy violation
account_signals.explanation: LLM classifiers explicitly flag engagement-bait and engagement-farming as spam violation types.

account_signals.name: Going viral triggers AI review
account_signals.value: min-traction streams; high-fav bucket at 128 likes
account_signals.explanation: Posts get LLM safety/quality review once they gain traction — virality invites scrutiny.

account_signals.name: AI grades posts for quality and 'slop'
account_signals.explanation: A model assigns quality and slop scores to notable posts, written back as labels ranking acts on.

account_signals.name: Standard penalty: hidden from non-followers
account_signals.explanation: Most enforcement isn't deletion — labeled accounts' posts stop being recommended to non-followers.

account_signals.name: NSFW avatar/banner limits the whole account
account_signals.explanation: An explicit profile picture or banner alone hides ALL your posts from non-followers' recommendations.

account_signals.name: Bot detection reads your activity rhythm
account_signals.explanation: A transformer reads the literal timing/cadence of your actions — mechanical patterns (follow-churn, like-drips, reply spam) get flagged.

reach_killers.name: Most limits hide you from non-followers only
reach_killers.explanation: Spam/NSFW/do-not-amplify labels usually don't hide posts from your followers — they silently remove you from strangers' For You feeds. That's why reach 'mysteriously' dies while followers still engage.

reach_killers.name: One unsafe link = 4 labels, retroactively
reach_killers.explanation: Linking a flagged URL removes the post from search, recommendations, and amplification — applied retroactively to every old post with that link.

reach_killers.name: Low-quality links + tagging strangers = spam label
reach_killers.explanation: Linking low-quality domains while @-mentioning non-followers gets the post spam-labeled and dropped from recommendations.

reach_killers.name: Duplicate text = copypasta spam
reach_killers.explanation: Posting the same text many other accounts post gets it labeled copypasta and downranked.

reach_killers.name: AI slop gets labeled
reach_killers.explanation: Accounts that mostly post AI-generated slop get an account-wide 30-day recommendations ban; slop replies get downranked 30 days.

reach_killers.name: 3 of last 5 posts NSFW = account flagged 7 days
reach_killers.explanation: Repeated NSFW posts flag your whole account for a week, ending recommendation reach for everything.

reach_killers.name: Spammy replies downranked 14 days
reach_killers.explanation: Replies the Grok-based spam model flags get buried in conversation threads for two weeks.

reach_killers.name: Extreme spam ratios kill your notifications
reach_killers.explanation: Accounts with extreme report-per-like ratios stop generating notifications — their likes/follows/replies notify no one.

reach_killers.name: Big/credible accounts are exempt
reach_killers.explanation: High-credibility, government, and business-verified accounts are exempt from nearly all automated demotion — they get human review instead.

reach_killers.name: Most limits expire
reach_killers.explanation: Most automated labels have expiry timers — reach limits are usually temporary if behavior changes.

discovery.name: Early likers define your post's community
discovery.explanation: A post's community identity is built in real time from the interests of whoever likes it, decaying with an 8-hour half-life — a clean niche audience in the first hours gives a strong discovery signal.

discovery.name: 8 likes to enter the discovery index
discovery.explanation: A post needs at least 8 likes before it enters the community-discovery index at all.

discovery.name: ~400 active followers to join communities
discovery.explanation: Creators need roughly 400 active followers before the weekly community-clustering job assigns them to any of the ~145,000 interest communities.

discovery.name: Likes teach retrieval to fetch your posts
discovery.explanation: The out-of-network retrieval model trains on likes as its positive signal — likes are weak for ranking but they're what gets you fetched for new audiences.

discovery.name: Reports/mutes train retrieval to avoid you
discovery.value: hard negatives: report, block, mute, not-interested
discovery.explanation: Negative feedback doesn't just sink one post — it trains the retrieval model to stop fetching content like yours.

discovery.name: The model's picture of a user: last ~1000 engagements
discovery.explanation: Ranking is a transformer over each viewer's last ~1000 engaged posts — your post wins by fitting that sequence.

discovery.name: Per-author caps: 50 originals / 30 replies per 48h
discovery.explanation: Only your latest ~50 original posts and ~30 replies within the 48h window can even be served in-network — volume beyond that is wasted.

discovery.name: No guaranteed follower quota
discovery.value: ~1200 in-network vs ~1800 OON candidates, one ranker
discovery.explanation: Followed-account posts and stranger posts compete in one ranker with no quota — following you doesn't guarantee seeing you.

discovery.name: Screenshots and translations are tracked actions
discovery.explanation: The model's action vocabulary includes screenshots, translate clicks, and how long people stay on links you share.

filters_and_gates.name: 48-hour age filter
filters_and_gates.explanation: Posts older than 48 hours are dropped from For You entirely.

filters_and_gates.name: OON retweet/reply filter
filters_and_gates.explanation: Your retweets and replies never reach non-followers' For You feeds — only original posts travel.

filters_and_gates.name: Thread dedup
filters_and_gates.explanation: Only the highest-scoring post from a thread survives into a feed.

filters_and_gates.name: 10-second video threshold
filters_and_gates.explanation: Video-view credit only applies to videos longer than 10 seconds.

filters_and_gates.name: Top-50 selection
filters_and_gates.explanation: Only the top 50 scored posts move forward; a feed page shows at most 35.
